title: CLCON/211/2010 of KEDAR NATH Vs DR. HARI GOPAL SHASTRI AND ANR

paras.text:
CLCON No.211 of 2010
Honíble Tarun Agarwala, J.
Mr. Jagdish Bisht, Advocate for the
applicant.
Mr. Pawan Mishra, Advocate for the
respondents.
The contemnors are present in the
Court today for the framing of the charge,
but before the charge could be framed, an
affidavit was filed by the contemnors
indicating compliance of the order of the
Court.
The learned counsel for the applicant
states that he has also received instructions
to intimate the Court that the order of the
writ court has now been complied with by
the opposite party.
In view of the aforesaid, notices are
discharged and the contempt application is
dismissed. Personal appearance is
accordingly dispensed with.
